invariants.rationale: Method calls on 'batch' would require that it is not null for the method to have behaved correctly.
Method calls on 'font' (specifically font.draw(...)) require 'font' to be non-null.
BitmapFont.draw typically requires the font to have an associated region (texture), indicating it's initialized correctly.
Drawing text at a negative X position may be undesirable; it's plausible text is only drawn at non-negative positions.
font.draw's substring indices (visibleTextStart, visibleTextEnd) should be well-formed.
